title: Workforce Skill meta.json
description: Workforce-specific operational metadata that lives alongside SKILL.md. Kept as a sidecar so SKILL.md stays portable to claude.ai / the Claude Agent Skills API.

name.description: Skill slug — the immutable identifier. Must equal SKILL.md:name and the directory name (Anthropic Agent Skills compatibility); rename via display_name, never by changing this.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable label, decoupled from the immutable slug (name). Renaming it never touches bindings, EXEC history, or URLs. API-writable post-seed (ADR-0017).

version.description: Semver. Bumped on Rule-11 SKILL.md body PRs. First version is 0.1.0.

status.description: Lifecycle. archived = soft delete: hidden from the default skill list, rejected as a NEW binding target; EXEC/deliverable history stays intact (ADR-0017).

archetype.description: Optional named skill archetype. "cadence": a scheduled, persona-voiced skill fired by EventBridge → wf-orchestrator-tick → the generic agent-runner CCR routine, whose context is composed from (agent × skill × project) and whose side effect is a deterministic bundled write-script POSTing to an authenticated endpoint with a project-scoped credential (no PR, no AWS access in-session). feed-post is the canonical first instance; new Cadences are produced by the .claude/skills/cadence-forge skill. When present, validate-skills.mjs enforces the archetype's structural invariants (see the C-* rules there). Absent for skills that don't fit a named archetype.

type.description: Deliverable shape produced by an llm-prose skill. Phase 7 PR6 adds `external-pr` — opens a PR against an external project's target repo per R-N9 (governance.md §4). The mechanical R-N9 gate IS this enum: `external-commit` deliberately does not exist, so a skill CANNOT declare 'I will push directly to the external repo's default branch'. `external-pr-merge` (added 2026-06-16 by the R-N10 Zone A amendment) marks the ONE delegated-merge exception: a skill may merge an external PR only under all four R-N10 clauses (target-statute delegation, server-side predicate, kill-switches, audit). Adding any further `external-*` type is a Zone A amendment requiring an explicit W-5 reconciliation.

article_type.description: Optional; only valid when deliverable.type=article. The Notion `Type` select the article-publish path writes (read by a skill's bundled write script, e.g. workforce/skills/article-level2/publish-notion.mjs) so the front-end labels/groups the article. Omitted for non-article deliverables and legacy article skills — the reader's resolveType then defaults to 'analysis'. See newsletter/pipeline/fetchers/notion.mjs:resolveType and newsletter/app/src/types/article.ts.

deliverable.description: Optional. Declares the S3 prefix + Notion publish flag for a skill's published artefact, read by the skill's bundled CCR write-script. Absent for skills with no published deliverable.

cost_class.description: Projected per-invocation cost. small ~$0.05, medium ~$0.20, large ~$0.60.

owners.description: Authorship/Rule-11/improvement owners of this Skill (slugs). Not a binding prerequisite (adr-0012) — any agent may bind any existing skill. Cross-checked against the agent roster.

improvement_agent.description: Agent slug assigned to improve this Skill. null until Epic-009 lands.

created_at.description: ISO date. Set on first PR; never edited.

requires.description: Credential keys this skill reads from ctx.credentials. Each entry is a base credential type (service.field) OR a variant suffix `type@name` (Epic-010 §Q2). The runner resolves each key from the active project at invocation time and seals the bag — undeclared access throws. The base-type allowlist + the variant suffix pattern are enforced both at lint (this schema) and runtime (credential-injector.ts). The `maxItems` bound caps the per-invocation Promise.all fan-out per cycle-1 review (Dario A2). To add a new base type, extend this pattern AND register the shape in shared/credential-injector.ts:CredentialShapes (see the file header there for all 5 mirror points).

commons.description: Epic-021 §B.1: this skill belongs to the commons — the baseline cadence every persona shares (daily reflection, daily research) rather than a designed, specialised duty. The idle-talent detector discounts commons executions when deciding whether a persona has produced non-commons deliverable rows in the trailing window, so the class is declared here, on the skill, and never as a name list inside the detector (Epic-021 Q3). Absent is equivalent to false. Generated into COMMONS_SKILLS by workforce/scripts/build-skill-registry.mjs.

recall_k.description: Epic-012 Story 1: how many past executions the runner semantically recalls and injects into this skill's prompt at run time. Omitted → runner default (RECALL_K_DEFAULT=3). Set 0 to opt a cheap/deterministic skill out of the recall packet. Capped at 20 to bound prompt budget + recall latency.
